# 10 Yellow Paints We Love


Our favorite yellow hues displayed in real homes as inspiration for your next project.


For many years I didn't understand why someone would want a yellow room. At its brightest, the shade can be easily described as "overwhelming".


But over the past few years, the use of mustard and golden yellows by interior designers, especially on cabinetry, had me betting a yellow shade would take the[2024 color of the year title](https://www.architecturaldigest.com/story/these-are-the-9-color-of-the-year-picks-that-companies-are-predicting-will-rule-2022) for one of the major brands. As far as I've seen, no yellow paints grabbed the crown this year.


Maybe I am ahead of the yellow trend. It was very easy to find 10 yellow shades we loved this year to act as inspiration for your next home project. Whether it's an accent wall, color blocking, cabinets, or a brilliant front door, I would add yellow paint into consideration.


These are Craftwork's favorite yellow paints:


## 1. Brittlebrush


Brittlebrush SW 6684 by Sherwin-Williams, featured on Apartment Therapy, photo by Jacqueline Marque


[Brittlebrush](https://www.sherwin-williams.com/en-us/color/color-family/yellow-paint-colors/sw6684-brittlebush) by Sherwin-Williams covers the guest bedroom of a New Orleans home, featured in[Apartment Therapy](https://www.apartmenttherapy.com/emily-andrews-colorful-new-orleans-home-house-tour-202681) . The deep, orange-like yellow is a regal shade that gives this room a lot of character.


## 2. Bold Yellow


Bold Yellow 336 by Benjamin Moore, featured in Apartment Therapy, photo by Nancy Mitchell


[Bold Yellow](https://www.benjaminmoore.com/en-us/paint-colors/color/336/bold-yellow) by Benjamin Moore, featured in[Apartment Therapy](https://www.apartmenttherapy.com/tour-cocktail-blogger-arsenic-laces-colorful-home-262254) , is color blocked on the office of Natalie Jacob's row house.


"Your house is a reflection of you. It doesn’t matter what anyone else thinks. It’s nice when other people like it and have positive things to say about it but you are the one that has to wake up and live with it every day. Fill it with things that make you happy and bring a smile to your face," Jacobs said.


## 3. Babouche


Babouche by Farrow & Ball, image from Melanie Gowen Design


Real Estate Designer[Melanie Gowen](https://melaniegowen.com/portfolio/) selected[Babouche](https://www.farrow-ball.com/en-us/paint-colours/babouche) by Farrow & Ball for this family room bar at a mid-century modern beach house.


"Winter days beckon for drawing sunshine inspiration from warmer places so palm springs modernism is on the mind," Gowen said.


## 4. Deserted Path


Deserted Path by Dunn Edward, featured in Apartment Therapy, photo by Margaret Wright


LA homeowners[Dani Nagel](https://www.instagram.com/dazey_la/) and Phillip Butler chose[Deserted Path](https://www.dunnedwards.com/colors/browser/de5367/) by Dunn-Edward for their bedroom, featured in[Apartment Therapy](https://www.apartmenttherapy.com/dazey-la-fashion-brand-colorful-house-tour-36661062) .


"We tied a pencil to a string attached to a nail in the wall to get the circle perfect," Dani said of the yellow dot framing the bed. "Don’t be afraid of color; it adds so much warmth and character to a space! Accent walls are a great way to get started."


## 5. Honeycomb


Honeycomb SW 6375 by Sherwin-Williams, featured in Apartment Therapy, photo by Minette Hand


The mustard yellow shade on these Georgia kitchen cabinets is[Honeycomb](https://www.sherwin-williams.com/en-us/color/color-family/orange-paint-colors/sw6375-honeycomb) by Sherwin-Williams, featured in[Apartment Therapy](https://www.apartmenttherapy.com/jodi-bond-house-on-a-sugar-hill-house-tour-36670566) . The pop of color brings a homey and warm vibe to the space.


## 6. Imperial Yellow


Imperial Yellow 314, featured in Apartment Therapy, photo by Marisa Vitale


[Imperial Yellow](https://www.benjaminmoore.com/en-us/paint-colors/color/314/imperial-yellow) by Benjamin Moore is the shade I imagine when asked to think of the color yellow, reminding me of sun flower petals and childhood. It was selected for the accent wall of an eclectic LA home, featured in[Apartment Therapy](https://www.apartmenttherapy.com/house-tour-an-eclectic-artsy-west-los-angeles-home-230649) .


## 7. India Yellow


India Yellow by Farrow & Ball, featured in House Beautiful, photo by Stephen Karlisch


The above kitchen was designed for the[2021 House Beautiful Whole Home](https://www.housebeautiful.com/whole-home-2021/) by[Sabbe Interiors](https://www.sabbeinteriordesign.com/) , featured on the[magazine's website](https://www.housebeautiful.com/design-inspiration/g40745951/fall-colors-2022/?slide=13) . The sunny space utilizes[India Yellow](https://www.farrow-ball.com/paint-colours/india-yellow) by Farrow & Ball on the cabinets and wainscoting backsplash.


Here's a fun fact about the inspiration for this colors name. Farrow & Ball said, "This deep mustard yellow is famously named after the pigment collected from the urine of cows fed on a special diet of mango leaves!"


## 8. Lemonade


Lemonade by Clare, featured in Ethel's Club


Coworking space[Ethel's Club](https://www.instagram.com/p/B47s5wrJ3YF/) in NYC used[Lemonade](https://www.clare.com/products/paint-lemonade) by Clare in their space, color blocking the shade for a modern design.


Clare describes the color as, "A cheerful, refreshing, and light lemony yellow, inspired by the summer drink. And also possibly by our favorite musical artist."


## 9. Nervy Hue


Nervy Hue SW 6917 by Sherwin-Williams, featured in Apartment Therapy, photo by Jacqueline Marque


[Nervy Hue](https://www.sherwin-williams.com/en-us/color/color-family/archived-paint-colors/sw6917-nervy-hue) by Sherwin-Williams fills this New Orleans living room with it's groovy, greenish shade, featured in[Apartment Therapy](https://www.apartmenttherapy.com/emily-andrews-colorful-new-orleans-home-house-tour-202681) .


"I get a lot of inspiration from art, and from the feeling you get when you are in a place that has history and grit," said homeowner Emily Rosenzweig.


## 10. Dash of Curry


Dash of Curry 2159-10 by Benjamin Moore, Featured in Elle Decor, photo by Douglas Friedman


Ken Fulk, an interior designer who has worked with Pharrell Williams and Gigi Hadid, painted his summer home in[Dash of Curry](https://www.benjaminmoore.com/en-us/paint-colors/color/2159-10/dash-of-curry) by Benjamin Moore. Featured in[Elle Decor](https://www.elledecor.com/design-decorate/room-ideas/g15926235/beach-house-decor-ideas/?slide=1) , this golden yellow creates a breathtaking environment that would impress any guest.
